prompt: Why is there a six-minute range rather than a bird count in the log?
promptZh: 紀錄為何列出六分鐘的區間，而沒有填鳥的數量？

options.text: An obstruction made part of the railing impossible to watch.
options.zh: 遮擋使部分欄杆無法觀察。
options.whyZh: 貨車擋住兩塊玻璃板；指示要求記錄遮擋時段，不憑猜測填數。

options.text: The volunteers had to leave the bridge for six minutes.
options.zh: 志工必須離開橋面六分鐘。
options.whyZh: 紀錄只說視線受阻，沒說人曾離開。

options.text: Two crew members came to count the birds.
options.whyZh: 郵件說兩名志工分工，沒說施工人員來數鳥。

options.text: The rescue desk closed for six minutes.
options.whyZh: 紀錄未提及救援站停業；六分鐘對應貨車遮擋。

explanationZh: 貨車擋住兩塊玻璃板；指示要求記錄遮擋時段，不憑猜測填數。
evidence:
Email | Rowan to Saturday volunteers
Use the new wall-side entrance this week; work crews have closed the stairs near the river. Our 8:00–9:00 session stays the same. Have one person watch the glass while the other fills in the sheet. If a crew vehicle blocks your view, write down the start and end of the obstruction instead of guessing what happened. | Field log | Saturday | Ivy and Leon
8:13 Two swallows passed in front of panel 4; both continued across the river.
8:26 One sparrow touched panel 2 and flew away.
8:41–8:47 A maintenance van hid panels 1 and 2.
8:52 One pigeon touched panel 4 and stayed on the ground; Ivy phoned the rescue desk.
